overview_description.description: Tofu is a developer of an AI-powered marketing platform designed to automate personalized B2B campaigns across multiple channels. The platform uses AI to research target accounts, generate tailored content, orchestrate marketing workflows, and optimize campaign execution, enabling sales and marketing teams to engage prospects and accelerate pipeline growth.
